title: ABS Document v0.1
description: Normative JSON Schema for Agent Behavior Specification v0.1 documents. A document that passes this schema is syntactically valid ABS v0.1. Semantic rules (variable resolution, ordering, target interpretation) are defined in SPECIFICATION.md and are not enforced by this schema.

description.description: Optional description of what this session covers.

abs_version.description: Version of the ABS spec this document targets. Optional in v0.1, RECOMMENDED, will be REQUIRED in v0.2.

dataset.description: Dataset that feeds this session. Each row triggers one execution. Columns are referenced as {{id.column}}.

id.description: Short name used to reference columns (e.g. {{cases.userQuery}}).

path.description: Path to a .json or .jsonl file relative to the session file.

behaviors.description: Ordered list of Behaviors and/or fragment includes. REQUIRED.

fragments.description: Named reusable lists of Behaviors. Referenced by include: entries in behaviors.

evaluations.description: Session-level (chain) evaluations operating over the whole trace.

include.description: Name of a fragment declared in the top-level fragments: map.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Behavior. Used by evaluations to reference steps via id.action.

actor.description: Who performs this Behavior: user, assistant, tool, system, human, external.

target.description: Object or destination of the action. Meaning depends on the action category — see SPECIFICATION.md §4.

content.description: Payload of the Behavior: free text, structured data, or displayed information.

capture.description: Names runtime values for later reuse via {{variable}} syntax.

with.description: Parameters passed on an outbound Action (typically calls). Partial match by default.

with_only.description: Parameters passed on an outbound Action. Strict match — exact keys only.

evaluations.description: Step-level evaluations for this Behavior only.

selector.description: Identifies Behaviors in the trace. A field that's present must match exactly; omitted is wildcard.
